title: Applicationservice accesses Dataobject
description: The application service's operations read, write or transform the data object as their input, output or working state: a domain object that keeps its own state consistent (a value object or an aggregate held in memory), or data with no declared shape. Use accesses to a data-model object schema instead when the value is held to a declared shape: an interface, record, struct, dataclass or DTO of only fields, or a persisted entity.
x-dr-evidence: The service interface or implementation takes, returns or mutates a domain object, e.g. a method signature `Money convert(Money amount, Currency to)` where Money has its own arithmetic and validation methods; or an operation takes or returns a value typed any, object, dict or Map<string, unknown>, or a parsed JSON value, that no interface, type or schema declares.
